label: analyst at
definition: Person X works as an analyst for or follows an industry or companies for organization Y.
scope_notes: Analyst-at/with/for dominates, preserving the prior analyst scope. Professorship, directorship or expertise alone does not establish an analyst role; these form competing components.

facts.reason: Peter Arenella is a professor and specialist at the University of California, without an analyst or industry-following path.
The sole path identifies Steven A. Wood as director at Bank of America, not an analyst.
Neil Sweig is explicitly analyst with, at and for Southeast Research Partners; the tracking path is consistent.
Julius Maldutis is explicitly analyst at, for and with Salomon Brothers; directorship is an additional role.
Judah Kraushaar is explicitly Merrill Lynch analyst and follows banks for the firm.
